Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 3746 -1966 

Indian Standard 

GRAPHICAL SYMBOLS FOR 
COAL PREPARATION PLANT 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institu- 
tion on 4 July 1966, after the draft finalized by the Solid Mineral 
Fuels Sectional Committee had been approved by the Chemical Division 
Council. 

0.2 In coal preparation industry, flow diagrams are widely used as 
a first drawing to show the basic items of major equipment and their 
relationship to one another in the entire process. Graphical symbols 
for the equipments used in a process, when connected by the flow 
lines, describe the sequence of operations in it. 

0.3 Keeping in view the continuous process of establishment of a large 
number of coal preparation plants in the country, it was felt that the 
adoption of standard symbols will simplify the exchange of information 
among those concerned with the design, construction and operation of 
coal preparation installations. 

0.4 In the formulation of this standard due weightage has been given 
to international co-ordination among the standards and practices pre- 
vailing in different countries in addition to relating it to the practices 
in this country. This has been met by basing the standard on Draft 
ISO Recommendation No. 604 * Graphical symbols for coal preparation 
plant' issued by the International Organization for Standardization 
(ISO). 

0,4.1 Most of the symbols given in the Draft ISO Recommendation 
No. 604 have been incorporated in this standard. The main points of 
difference relate to feeders, breakers, crushers and some types of 
screens. Additional symbols for sieve-bend or arc screen, fixed screen 
or grizzley, demagnetizer, liquid reagent feeder, diaphragm pump and 
heavy medium cyclone washer have been added. 

0.5 For symbols used in the basic process flow diagrams for representing 
the major items of equipment used by the petroleum and chemical 
industries, those recommended in IS : 3232-1965* shall be used. 



♦Recommendations on graphical symbols for process flow diagrams. 

3 



IS : 3746 - 1966 

1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard prescribes standard symbols for use in the basic 
process flow diagrams and others relating to coal preparation 

plants. 

2. PRINCIPLES 

2.1 The symbols incorporated in this standard have been selected 
in accordance with the following principles: 

a) The items of the plant listed should be widely used for 
coal preparation and required to be identified on flow sheets. 

b) The symbols should be easy to draw and distinguishable readily 
from one another. 

c) The symbols should preferably give some indications of the prin- 
ciple of the operation involved, but should not represent the 
appearance of any particular type of machine. 

3. CONVENTIONS FOR THE DRAWING OF SYMBOLS 

3.1 The following conventions shall be adopted for drawing the 
standard symbols: 

a) The plant symbols shall be shown by heavy lines and the product 
flow by light lines. 

b) In general, the flow lines shall enter the symbols from above or 
from the left and shall leave the symbol downwards or to 
the right. 

c) Where more than one product enters or leaves an item of plant, 
the numbers of entry and exit arrows shall be varied accord- 
ingly. 

4. GRAPHICAL SYMBOLS
